checks.expect: scheduled entries have verified playable full-program sources
enough unique playable inventory for requested schedule without premature repeats
no overlap, gaps, duplicate IDs, or invalid timing
Cloudflare /v1/now/:channel returns valid current program and elapsed offset
connected channels consume central now response and retain local fallback
actual scheduled media plays in-page and belongs to the requested channel
next program starts correctly when current program ends
shared unified wallet is used; no divergent channel-local balance
ownership/sign-in boundary exists before user-to-user value transfer is treated as complete
